name: Bay Shore
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Bay Shore, NY 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Bay Shore, NY for 2026: Brunch with Santa at Brightwaters Farms and ChristmasLand at Tanger Outlets Deer Park.
lede: Bay Shore families can book Brunch with Santa and a sleigh hay ride at Brightwaters Farms, or take a timed walk through ChristmasLand in nearby Deer Park.
celebrates: Brightwaters Farms opens its Christmas Extravaganza on Friday, November 27, 2026, at 1624 Manatuck Boulevard, with a country store, a nursery where families pick their own tree, a sleigh hay ride and Brunch with Santa at four seatings. Adults are $45.99 and children 2 to 12 are $25.99 before taxes and fees, and every family gets a free picture with Santa. In nearby Deer Park, ChristmasLand fills 20,000 square feet of Tanger Outlets with themed photo rooms and Santa, open from November 13 to December 27 with timed entry at $35 for ages 3 and up.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap of Bay Shore's events on a host page. ChristmasLand describes itself as in its sixth season, so it has run each year in the outlet center. Brightwaters Farms lists its Christmas Extravaganza without a closing date, so this page does not state when it ends. Because both hosts publish only current season information, families should check each host's own website for the latest dates, seatings and ticket availability before they book, especially for the Brunch with Santa seatings.
facts: Brightwaters Farms lists weekly hours of Monday to Thursday noon to 6 pm, Friday noon to 8 pm, Saturday 9 am to 8 pm and Sunday 9 am to 6 pm, with Black Friday 9 am to 8 pm. ChristmasLand is on the second floor of Tanger Outlets Deer Park and lists free parking. Deer Park folds into Bay Shore as a small neighbor on the same stretch of Long Island.
trains: Ride the rails to the holidays. The MTA says the Long Island Rail Road's Holiday Lights Train, a locomotive covered in thousands of lights, runs along all electric branches from Monday, November 23 into January, so families who ride the LIRR this season may spot it. Check the LIRR timetable before you plan a train trip to the events on this page, and bring the children to the window to look for the glowing locomotive.
traditions: Four seatings of a buffet brunch with a free family picture with Santa.
A hay ride at Brightwaters Farms.
A nursery with trees at the farm.
Themed rooms with Santa and photos included.
kidfact: At ChristmasLand, children under 3 are free and all the photos are included with the ticket.
faq: How does Bay Shore celebrate Christmas?
Families visit Brightwaters Farms for Brunch with Santa, a sleigh hay ride and a tree, and many also take the short drive to ChristmasLand at Tanger Outlets Deer Park.
How much is Brunch with Santa at Brightwaters Farms?
Adults are $45.99 and children 2 to 12 are $25.99 before taxes and fees, and children under 2 are free.
General admission is $35 for ages 3 and up, children under 3 are free, and family bundles start at $28 a guest.
